papers.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
papers.brief: AgentBaton让强模型与低成本模型在同一长程任务中接力。它用轻量检测器学习任务进展中的重复模式，判断何时从强模型一次性交接给低成本模型。
papers.tldr: 通过强模型向低成本模型的适时交接，显著降低长程智能体任务成本并保持准确率。
papers.what_it_is: AgentBaton让强模型与低成本模型在同一长程任务中接力。它用轻量检测器学习任务进展中的重复模式，判断何时从强模型一次性交接给低成本模型。
key_points: 系统比较模型交接方向与上下文传递方式
覆盖11组模型配对、2个基准，平均API成本降低65.9%
适时由强转弱基本保持准确率，最高提升8.8个百分点
papers.why_notable: 将模型协作从整条请求的路由推进到任务内部交接，表明简单的一次接力即可显著降本，并拓展准确率与成本的经验帕累托前沿。
papers.abstract: Solving long-horizon agentic tasks requires language agents to interact with their environments over multiple steps, and reliable performance often comes from the expensive capable models available through cloud providers. Meanwhile, alternative efficient models with inferior performance but a much lower cost are emerging, including lower-tier cloud models and smaller open-weights models deployable on local hardware. This raises a natural question that remains less explored than traditional query-level routing: can capable and efficient models collaborate within a single long-horizon agentic task to substantially reduce cost while preserving task accuracy? In this paper, we systematically investigate key design choices for such collaboration through model handoffs, where one model takes over from another, focusing on handoff direction and context transfer. We find that efficient-to-capable handoffs generally underperform capable-only execution with limited or even no cost reduction, whereas capable-to-efficient handoffs at suitable stages of task progress largely preserve or even improve accuracy while substantially reducing cost. These findings suggest that a one-time, simple, well-timed handoff strategy is good enough for cost-effective agent collaboration, motivating AgentBaton, a lightweight detector that learns when to hand off from recurring patterns in task progress. Across 11 model pairs and two representative benchmarks, AgentBaton reduces API costs by 65.9% on average while largely preserving task accuracy, with accuracy gains of up to 8.8 percentage points over capable-only execution. Experiments across various reasoning-effort settings further show that AgentBaton extends the empirical accuracy-cost Pareto frontier.

papers.abstract: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.

papers.title: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
papers.brief: HiRes将层分组，组内沿用窄维PreNorm层，组间用宽维PostNorm残差连接，并以可学习读写投影衔接，使残差宽度独立于计算宽度。
papers.tldr: 通过分层残差扩宽跨层状态而不增加层内计算宽度，提升训练效率与性能。
papers.what_it_is: HiRes将层分组，组内沿用窄维PreNorm层，组间用宽维PostNorm残差连接，并以可学习读写投影衔接，使残差宽度独立于计算宽度。
key_points: 拟合缩放律显示FLOPs效率提升至1.30倍
OLMoE预训练500B词元，下游准确率提高1.14点
相比VWN、mHC和AttnRes，激活内存与I/O成本更低
papers.why_notable: 把残差宽度变成可独立调节的扩展变量，且仅需标准投影与归一化算子，为提高模型效率提供易落地的架构改动。
papers.abstract: Residual connections underpin Transformers, but they implicitly tie the residual width carried through depth to the compute width used inside each layer. We introduce Hierarchical Residuals (HiRes), a minimalist architectural change that decouples these dimensions, widening the residual state while keeping per-layer compute width fixed. HiRes groups layers into blocks: standard d-dimensional PreNorm layers operate inside each block, while a wider D-dimensional PostNorm outer residual connects blocks. Learned read/write projections bridge the two spaces at block boundaries, leaving individual Transformer layers unchanged. Across different model sizes and depths, HiRes consistently outperforms vanilla residual addition, with fitted scaling laws indicating a 1.30-fold improvement in FLOPs efficiency. On OLMoE-1B-7B pretraining for 500B tokens, HiRes achieves 0.0208 lower training loss and 1.14-point higher downstream accuracy. HiRes is also competitive with other residual expansion methods such as VWN, mHC and AttnRes with less activation memory and I/O costs. Built from only dense projections and normalizations, it requires neither specialized kernels nor infrastructure-level optimizations. HiRes thus exposes residual width as a practical scaling variable using only standard operators.

papers.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
papers.brief: AutoCompress通过可微架构搜索联合优化全局与逐层结构，生成异构模型；以经实测验证的服务引擎成本模型约束延迟、吞吐和显存。
papers.tldr: 将硬件与服务约束直接纳入大模型剪枝搜索，兼顾部署效率与精度。
papers.what_it_is: AutoCompress通过可微架构搜索联合优化全局与逐层结构，生成异构模型；以经实测验证的服务引擎成本模型约束延迟、吞吐和显存。
key_points: 可微架构搜索联合优化全局及逐层结构
对比Minitron，八项基准平均精度最高提升6.57个百分点
120B压至74B，单B200支持128K上下文，保留95%均分
papers.why_notable: 把剪枝目标从参数量转向实际部署约束，减少人工选型；跨消费级与数据中心硬件的结果显示，硬件适配可改善压缩后的精度。
papers.abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.

papers.title: OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer
papers.brief: OneTrans-GSR以单个仅解码器模型端到端生成混合内容展示列表。训练时用整列表奖励指导强化学习，解码时显式执行业务约束。
papers.tldr: 用自回归模型统一推荐重排与混排，在工业部署中提升收益并降低延迟。
papers.what_it_is: OneTrans-GSR以单个仅解码器模型端到端生成混合内容展示列表。训练时用整列表奖励指导强化学习，解码时显式执行业务约束。
key_points: 基于OneTrans，以自回归策略统一重排与混排
奖励模型评估完整列表，优化列表级与长期目标
线上人均GMV提升2.63%，端到端延迟降低13%
papers.why_notable: 将人工规则主导的列表编排转为可学习策略，并在工业系统验证收益；离线结果显示，奖励模型与策略计算量增加可持续改善列表质量。
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring, yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels. Although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge, they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation. They constrain the combinatorial space of candidate slates and determine objective trade-offs through manual tuning. To enable scalable and effective slate generation, we reformulate reranking and mix-ranking as a unified learning problem whose performance can improve with computation. Specifically, we instantiate this formulation across the reranking and mix-ranking stages and propose OneTrans-GSR, a single decoder-only policy that extends our deployed OneTrans backbone to generate the exposure slate end-to-end. During training, a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives. During decoding, business constraints are explicitly enforced. Offline evaluation shows that slate quality consistently improves as reward-model and policy compute increase. Deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system, OneTrans-GSR mixes heterogeneous content types within a unified slate. In online A/B tests, it improves GMV/u by 2.63%, advertiser value by 2.06%, and repurchase rate by 2.03%, while reducing end-to-end latency across the reranking and mix-ranking stages by 13%. These results mark a paradigm shift in slate generation: moving beyond human-engineered heuristics toward a general learned policy creates a scalable path for further algorithmic optimization and compute-driven improvement.

papers.brief: 训练能自主编写并执行代码的视频生成智能体，用动态三维场景草稿为下游模型提供结构和运动信号。先做监督微调，再结合执行与视频双奖励开展强化学习。
papers.tldr: 让智能体写代码构建动态三维场景，再引导视频生成，提升结构与运动可控性。
papers.what_it_is: 训练能自主编写并执行代码的视频生成智能体，用动态三维场景草稿为下游模型提供结构和运动信号。先做监督微调，再结合执行与视频双奖励开展强化学习。
key_points: 构建SFT-6k与RL-2k数据集，配套执行和渲染环境
双奖励强化学习中逐步降低执行奖励权重
Minimax-H3在两项基准上分别提升约7和24分
papers.why_notable: 将代码执行与三维渲染接入视频生成，为精确控制场景和运动提供新路径；数据、模型与代码全部开源，便于复用。
papers.abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code

papers.what_it_is: 该系统将电路板图像与结构化电气、几何信息交给全局规划器，再由执行器调用 KiCad 完成布线；失败以结构化反馈触发定向修订，并保留已接受的走线。

papers.abstract: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.

papers.title: "PRISM" Is Not All You Need: Cross-Topic Name Collisions and Scientific Paper Retrieval
papers.brief: 研究分析AI相关arXiv论文的跨主题撞名趋势，并用统一三词查询测试论文识别能力，通过词法、稠密检索与语言模型排序区分歧义来源。
papers.tldr: 科研命名跨主题撞名显著加剧检索歧义，补充上下文可缓解但难以消除
papers.what_it_is: 研究分析AI相关arXiv论文的跨主题撞名趋势，并用统一三词查询测试论文识别能力，通过词法、稠密检索与语言模型排序区分歧义来源。
key_points: 564,861条记录：跨主题撞名增至4.33倍
撞名目标识别率差距：BM25为25.7、E5为6.9个百分点
固定同名候选中，语言模型列表排序准确率达89.2%
papers.why_notable: 将科研撞名转化为可量化的检索问题，并提供可复用评测集，为科学检索与研究助手的上下文消歧设计提供依据。
papers.abstract: Scientific names increasingly connect papers from different research topics, leaving readers to recover a paper's identity from context. We study this convergence in 564,861 AI-related arXiv records. Cross-topic name collision grows 4.33-fold from a pooled 2020-2022 reference to 2026, compared with 1.12-fold within topics. A second sentence encoder reproduces the pattern, and name-group resampling quantifies its uncertainty. Fixed word-frequency bands locate the main increase in an intermediate-frequency vocabulary shared by many research areas. We then measure the ambiguity that remains after supplying research clues. With the same three-term query construction, shared-name targets retain matched identification deficits of 25.7 percentage points under title-based BM25 and 6.9 points under title-plus-abstract E5. Within fixed same-name candidates, listwise language-model ranking reaches 89.2% using the query and candidate titles. Topic-specific comparisons show that context resolves more cross-topic ambiguity. The evaluation separates candidate competition, document fields, and contextual ranking through lexical, dense, and language-model baselines. Source-linked cases and a portable evaluation collection make the phenomenon inspectable and reusable for scientific retrieval and research assistants.

papers.title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
papers.brief: 将低秩适配的Qwen3.5-0.8B限制为每步读取纸面三个单元，输出数字、进借位与下一操作。运行时仅移动视图，算术结果由模型生成。
papers.tldr: 通过有限局部视图验证，让小型视觉语言模型获得任意长度算术的精确性保证。
papers.what_it_is: 将低秩适配的Qwen3.5-0.8B限制为每步读取纸面三个单元，输出数字、进借位与下一操作。运行时仅移动视图，算术结果由模型生成。
key_points: Lean证明：局部视图全正确等价于任意长度精确
部署端全部2,446个视图验证通过
浏览器测试200题全对，另220题亦全对
papers.why_notable: 把抽样准确率提升为可检查的全长度保证，同时保留网络内部算术计算；证明还覆盖有界数值扰动与多过程组合。
papers.abstract: Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots and greatest common divisors at arbitrary length. It solved 200 of 200 pre-registered problems in the browser, and 220 of 220 sums of up to 1,000 digits and products of up to 20 digits, of which GPT-6.1 Sol, the strongest of ten other models, solved 217. A symbolic runtime built on these procedures solves, expands and factors polynomials with every number computed by the model, and a multiplicative gate on the adapter recovers the base model exactly when the sheet is not in use.

papers.what_it_is: A2-MEAS将语言纠正、空间证据与执行历史编码为纠错代码，由MetaBrain指导训练和部署；动作策略结合运动历史与潜在世界模型，部署时冻结权重仍可纠错。

papers.abstract: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.

papers.abstract: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.

papers.abstract: Local AI promises capable personal assistants that run on users' own devices, keeping data and computation under their control. Open-weight models that fit on local devices can now handle practical tasks such as coding. Yet current inference engines fall short. Popular engines such as vLLM and SGLang target datacenter GPUs with dedicated host memory, while local engines underuse the memory hierarchy of unified-memory devices. We present Hibana, an inference engine for unified-memory devices that co-optimizes model representation, memory management, and decoding strategy. Model surgery, the process of editing a trained model's architecture to suit its hardware, changes how the model computes, shrinking its memory footprint and data movement. Unified-memory management preserves each agent's state across turns, so long-running agents can resume instantly instead of recomputing their state. Adaptive speculation generates several tokens per step. Hibana codesigns these features around the shared memory capacity and limited bandwidth of unified-memory systems-on-chip to support local multi-agent workloads. On a single DGX Spark serving Qwen and Nemotron models of up to 125B parameters, Hibana completes up to 3.4$\times$ more agentic tasks per hour and delivers up to 3.9$\times$ higher decoding throughput than other established frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Flare, llama.cpp, and TensorFold. Code is available at https://github.com/sharar-project/hibana.

papers.abstract: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.

papers.what_it_is: 构建兼容Jev的多智能体交易系统，以时点存储和类型化问答隔离信息，并用可证明边界限制文本对仓位的影响，检验新闻判断是在识别事件还是追随价格。

To answer, we built a multi-agent trading system whose agents share only point-in-time stores and answer typed questions through the interface of Jev, a hosted typed decision model; code sets every position under a proved bound on how far text can move it. In a hash-committed test of a Jev-compatible reader built from a pinned LLM's option probabilities, item judgments track announcement-window abnormal returns (weekly Spearman 0.119), also after the LLM's release, and event types agree with the issuers' 8-K filings (AUC 0.833); Jev's judgments of news published after its own release track the reaction as well (descriptive). Exploratory analyses show where the association comes from: 72% of earnings news items appear after the issuer's filing, contributor-written items often report the price move, and from the first trade after publication the association falls to 0.023. At a weekly horizon, the confirmatory test detects no rank information over code-only features. Under attack, decision cards traced 88% of successful attacks to the planted item. We propose that market-graded tests of Web-text readers report the criterion from publication, not only from the event.

papers.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P$^2$-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P$^2$-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P$^2$-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.

papers.abstract: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights. We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement. We evaluate four methods across harnesses, general and coding tasks. Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns. All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones. In one general-task case, reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten previously covered tasks. Most reliability gains also increase deployment cost. Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, but their benefits can change when combined. The highest-scoring agent does not yield the largest mean improvement in any of our four pools, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives. Transfer selectively preserves gains: coverage usually falls on the general-task target across both harness types and paradigms, but rises on the coding target with the outer-layer-only harness. These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions. As a constructive follow-up, EvoAudit turns these diagnostics into revisions of select, analyze, mutate, and gate, achieving the best performance.

papers.brief: 将加性相对位置项融入 FlashAttention 式分块计算，保持注意力精确性。以偏移感知分块、关系乘积复用和梯度分片聚合，构建统一的 Triton 实现。

papers.what_it_is: 将加性相对位置项融入 FlashAttention 式分块计算，保持注意力精确性。以偏移感知分块、关系乘积复用和梯度分片聚合，构建统一的 Triton 实现。

papers.abstract: Relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to RoPE across various transformer architectures, delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. These mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. Unlike RoPE, which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys, relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups, complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory, bandwidth, and compute overheads as sequences scale. To address this bottleneck, we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation. Our method (1) uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses, (2) computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes, and (3) uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation, eliminating atomic contention. We provide a unified, efficient Triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. For 8K-token sequences, our method speeds up the forward (backward) pass by 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$) and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$) over the strongest baseline for each mechanism, enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8$\times$ faster and uses 2.4$\times$ less memory. Our method thus provides a drop-in, hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.brief: LowRAM在测试时为每个注意力头拟合键到值的轻量预测器，仅保存难重建词元的残差，再结合跨层低秩键压缩，构成非对称缓存压缩流程。
papers.tldr: 利用键预测值并结合低秩压缩，大幅缩减缓存且提升长上下文解码吞吐。
papers.what_it_is: LowRAM在测试时为每个注意力头拟合键到值的轻量预测器，仅保存难重建词元的残差，再结合跨层低秩键压缩，构成非对称缓存压缩流程。
key_points: 值缓存摊销实现4倍近无损压缩，元学习降低预填充开销
选择性重建KV对，4倍压缩下峰值解码吞吐最高提升5倍
叠加量化与淘汰达26.9倍压缩，保留94.5%基线性能
papers.why_notable: 揭示键和值之间可利用的预测关系，为缓存压缩增加互补维度；在三类模型上接近无损，并可与既有压缩方法组合。
papers.abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.

papers.what_it_is: 提出带驻留大模型的可复用原语，让资源具备结合上下文执行的能力。HEELO将原语组成任务图，依据环境证据验证结果，并修订、验证和积累原语。

papers.abstract: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ less time and 1.55$\times$ lower cost per completed task.

papers.what_it_is: 构建覆盖物体、场景和交互开放世界的三维创作基准，联合评估外观、结构与行为，并比较不同模型与执行框架组合的能力差异。

GPT-6.1-sol总分最高，为66.02/100。
局部机制得分83.08，状态化工作流仅30.26。

papers.abstract: Coding agents combine visual understanding with program execution, offering a new route to automated 3D creation. By translating images and instructions into editable programs, they bring reconstruction, generation, and editing into a shared workflow. Yet existing benchmarks fragment evaluation across task scopes and protocols, leaving their capabilities across construction levels unclear. We propose Frontier3DBench, a unified benchmark of 145 tasks across 9 categories spanning object, scene, and interactive open-world creation, with joint evaluation of appearance, structure, and behavior. Experiments with 11 model-harness configurations reveal strengths that vary by level: GPT-6.1-sol leads the object and scene levels and achieves the highest overall score of 66.02/100, whereas GPT-6-astra leads interactive world construction. However, all configurations score lower on reference reconstruction than on text-driven generation in object and scene tasks. Producing plausible content thus remains easier than reproducing specified geometry, layouts, and visual details. Moreover, generated worlds average 83.08/100 on local mechanisms but only 20.82 on motion clearance and 30.26 on stateful workflows: individual mechanisms often function, whereas complete activities that require coordinated actions and persistent state remain difficult. These results identify reference fidelity and coordinated activity completion as central bottlenecks for coding agents in 3D creation.

papers.abstract: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge. Despite growing interest in these approaches, there has been no systematic way to evaluate how well models perform them. We introduce IWIBench, which measures a large editor model's ability to modify the weights of a smaller target model (typically Gemma 3 4B IT) to achieve one of ten classical text-editing objectives while preserving its other capabilities. Editors are limited to four tools for reading and writing weights, with bounded tensor access and a fixed budget for generating and inspecting rollouts. A validator applies each proposed patch in a clean environment and compares the edited model against the unmodified target. Evaluating frontier closed- and open-weight models reveals sharply diverging capabilities, both across models and across tasks. A small number of models, most notably Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, perform far ahead of the rest. The recency of this ability (little of it is evident in GPT-5.6 Sol, for instance), together with qualitative analysis, suggests it has been acquired through recent training. Tasks also vary widely: structured response resisted every attempt, and answer-length control yielded only one successful solution, whereas alias acquisition and recoding proved most amenable. Success in one task family correlated poorly with success in others, indicating an early and uneven capability frontier. We discuss strategies that editors repeatedly adopted and conclude with an outlook on intra-weight injection as an emerging but already potent approach to gradient-free behaviour modification.

papers.title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
papers.brief: 提出TOPSD，按教师与学生的似然估计教师偏离正确推理的位置，截取监督前缀；再验证教师能否从此前缀恢复正确答案，仅对通过验证的前缀进行蒸馏。
papers.tldr: 通过筛选教师能纠正的推理前缀，提升多语言自蒸馏效果，尤其惠及低资源语言。
papers.what_it_is: 提出TOPSD，按教师与学生的似然估计教师偏离正确推理的位置，截取监督前缀；再验证教师能否从此前缀恢复正确答案，仅对通过验证的前缀进行蒸馏。
key_points: Teacher Drift在低资源语言中更早出现
TOPSD结合似然估计与答案恢复验证筛选前缀
覆盖10种语言、3种模型规模，持续优于OPSD
papers.why_notable: 将监督选择细化到推理前缀，减少教师顺从学生错误的风险，为多语言自蒸馏提供更可靠的训练信号，低中资源语言收益尤其明显。
papers.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.

papers.title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
papers.brief: 提出系统构建的功能基序支架设计基准BILBY-PRO，并用BILBY-MD全原子分子动力学框架，对照参考模拟检验设计的动态保真度。
papers.tldr: 蛋白质支架设计的静态成功不等于动态稳定，新基准揭示两者差距。
papers.what_it_is: 提出系统构建的功能基序支架设计基准BILBY-PRO，并用BILBY-MD全原子分子动力学框架，对照参考模拟检验设计的动态保真度。
key_points: BILBY-PRO覆盖174个PROSITE条目的220例
六模型对比：ESM3在已解决目标上产出更多独特支架
BILBY-MD评估55组静态成功设计，仅8组通过全部检查
papers.why_notable: 将评估从静态结构恢复扩展到动态保真度，并区分目标覆盖与独特解产量，为筛选更可靠的蛋白质设计提供依据。
papers.abstract: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.

papers.title: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
papers.brief: 用神经常微分方程学习动作向量场，以积分后的动作匹配训练目标，并用轻量多样性头建模多模态行为。部署时从上一动作积分得到下一动作，保证轨迹连续。
papers.tldr: 通过学习动作变化的向量场而非直接预测动作，实现连续、平滑且高效的机器人控制。
papers.what_it_is: 用神经常微分方程学习动作向量场，以积分后的动作匹配训练目标，并用轻量多样性头建模多模态行为。部署时从上一动作积分得到下一动作，保证轨迹连续。
key_points: 神经ODE在模仿学习中匹配动作片段，在强化学习中匹配单步动作
训练一轮后，较流匹配成功率达5.9倍，动作生成快10.8倍
对比14个基线，在14项真实机器人任务中取得最高成功率
papers.why_notable: 将动作连续性直接嵌入策略结构，而非依赖隐式学习；同一方法覆盖模仿学习、强化学习及多类机器人，兼顾平滑控制与执行效率。
papers.abstract: Most robot policies, whether trained by imitation learning (IL) or reinforcement learning (RL), map observations to action values at discrete control steps and leave the continuity of physical motion to be learned implicitly. We propose ODE policy, which learns the dynamics of the action rather than the action itself. A neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) learns the vector field of the action by matching the integrated actions to the targets over short action chunks in IL and single control steps in RL. A lightweight diversity head captures multi-modal behavior by randomizing the direction of the field. At deployment, each action is integrated from the previous one, so the executed trajectory is continuous by construction. We evaluate it as a visuomotor policy, as the action head of vision-language-action (VLA) and world action models (WAMs), and as the actor of model-based RL against 14 baselines on unimanual, bimanual, dexterous, locomotion, and loco-manipulation tasks. In IL, against flow matching, it reaches 5.9$\times$ the success, 5.4$\times$ the generalization, and 3.9$\times$ the mode balance after one epoch, and generates actions 10.8$\times$ faster. It mostly moves more smoothly than human demonstrations. On 14 real-world tasks across single-arm, dual-arm, dexterous, and humanoid robots, it achieves the highest success rate. In RL, it further speeds up SuperMimic for humanoid motion tracking and smooths its actions. Efficient in learning, data, parameters, and execution, ODE policy offers a promising path to scaling robot learning.

papers.title: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
papers.brief: OmniLatent联合编码几何、形变、外观与二值部件标识，借助几何和视觉先验学习部件划分；从单图一次生成带分区的三维资产，无需后置分割。
papers.tldr: 通过统一潜空间，从单张图像直接生成带部件划分的三维资产，并支持交互编辑与补全。
papers.what_it_is: OmniLatent联合编码几何、形变、外观与二值部件标识，借助几何和视觉先验学习部件划分；从单图一次生成带分区的三维资产，无需后置分割。
key_points: 共享潜空间联合建模几何、形变、外观和二值部件标识
点提示适配器将三维提示点映射为潜变量令牌，支持细分
动态部件令牌分配结合局部与全局注意力，补全局部掩码
papers.why_notable: 将部件划分融入三维生成，减少对后置网格分割的依赖；同时支持交互细化与完整部件补全，为可编辑资产创建提供统一路径。
papers.abstract: 3D part decomposition is a central capability for editable asset creation, yet existing workflows typically segment a completed mesh as a post-processing step, making the result sensitive to geometric artifacts, texture ambiguity, and limited part-level annotations. We present OmniLatent, a unified latent modeling framework for 3D part decomposition. Instead of predicting part labels in isolation, OmniLatent learns a shared latent space that jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and binary part IDs, allowing data-rich geometric and visual priors to support data-scarce part learning. Given a single input image, the base model generates geometry, deformation, texture, and surface part IDs in one pass, producing a part-aware 3D asset without a separate segmentation stage. We further tune the pretrained model for two extensions: a point-prompt adapter that maps arbitrary 3D point prompts with binary part IDs into latent tokens for full segmentation, refinement, and part subdivision, and an amodal part completion model that completes partial surface masks into a coherent full-object decomposition through dynamic per-part token allocation, cross-attention to the given geometry latent, and alternating part-local and global attention. Extensive experiments show that OmniLatent produces semantically meaningful part segmentations with precise boundaries, supports interactive part editing, and completes partial part observations while preserving global object consistency.

papers.title: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
papers.brief: 提出速度匹配（VM）目标，用分段线性插值与随机配点学习连续时间速度场，无需训练时仿真。该目标以采样步长二阶精度近似速度总体风险。
papers.tldr: 通过直接匹配速度学习非线性动力学，免去训练仿真并缓解长轨迹优化失稳。
papers.what_it_is: 提出速度匹配（VM）目标，用分段线性插值与随机配点学习连续时间速度场，无需训练时仿真。该目标以采样步长二阶精度近似速度总体风险。
key_points: 揭示长轨迹目标退化及数值稳定域对雅可比谱的偏置
VM结合分段线性插值与随机配点，免仿真训练
在非线性ODE与半离散PDE上，精度优于轨迹目标
papers.why_notable: 将动力学学习从长程仿真转向局部速度约束，并建立速度误差控制轨迹误差的理论，为低成本、稳定的连续时间建模提供依据。
papers.abstract: Learning the continuous-time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems relies on trajectory-based objectives, which require simulating the learned dynamics during training and backpropagating through the numerical scheme, at a cost that grows with the rollout horizon. We show that trajectory-based objectives degenerate as the rollout horizon increases, hindering gradient-based optimization, and that the numerical scheme biases the learned dynamics by constraining the spectrum of the learned Jacobian to its absolute stability region. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Velocity Matching (VM), a simulation-free objective that relies on piecewise-linear interpolation and stochastic collocation, and approximates the velocity population risk to second order in the sampling step. We develop a theoretical framework for velocity-based learning, introducing stability estimates that control trajectory errors in terms of velocity errors, which enable us to establish universal and continuous-time approximation results when the learned velocity field is parameterized by deep neural networks. Building on a bias-variance decomposition of the VM objective, we show that its higher-order approximation of the velocity population risk yields a consistent minimizer; that it relates to the residual of an A-stable continuous-stage Runge-Kutta scheme, thus connecting VM to implicit integration without requiring any implicit solve; and that it implicitly matches the action of the learned Jacobian to that of the true one along the observed trajectories, without requiring access to the underlying velocity field or its Jacobian. Numerical experiments on nonlinear ordinary differential equations and semi-discretized time-dependent partial differential equations show that VM improves accuracy over trajectory-based objectives, while avoiding both the cost of simulation and the instabilities of long rollouts.

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for Diffusion Language Models with Frequency-Aware Remasking
papers.brief: 提出两阶段推理策略：先用快速采样器解决简单题，再对难题采用频率感知重掩码。它统计词元预测在去噪中的变化次数，优先确定频繁变化的词元，以探索不同推理路径。
papers.tldr: 通过词元预测变化频率引导重掩码，让扩散语言模型将推理算力用于探索难题新解。
papers.what_it_is: 提出两阶段推理策略：先用快速采样器解决简单题，再对难题采用频率感知重掩码。它统计词元预测在去噪中的变化次数，优先确定频繁变化的词元，以探索不同推理路径。
key_points: 频率感知重掩码按跨去噪步骤的预测变化次数选择词元
MATH-500准确率最高提升：LLaDA 3.73、Dream 7.33个百分点
基础策略采样100次仍未解题中，恢复3.75%至18.75%的解
papers.why_notable: 把测试时扩展从增加采样次数推进到调整解码路径，在数学与代码任务上均有增益，并能找回常规置信度策略反复采样仍遗漏的解。
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality. Existing certainty-aware strategies rely on instantaneous confidence or entropy, but these local signals can be misleading on difficult reasoning problems. We formulate DLM test-time scaling as adaptive allocation of both inference compute and decoding strategies. Our two-stage approach uses a fast base sampler to solve easy questions, then applies frequency-aware remasking to the remaining hard questions. This strategy tracks how often each token's prediction changes across denoising steps and preferentially commits frequently changing tokens, encouraging samples to explore alternative reasoning paths rather than collapse onto the model's preferred trajectory. Experiments with LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct show consistent improvements over a strong adaptive allocation baseline, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 3.73 percentage points (LLaDA) and 7.33 percentage points (Dream) on MATH-500, and absolute coverage gains of up to 11.39 percentage points (LLaDA) and 10.98 percentage points (Dream) on HumanEval. On questions unsolved by the base certainty-aware strategy after 100 samples, frequency-aware remasking recovers solutions for 3.75% to 18.75% of examples.

papers.title: LongCapHarness: Capability-Guided Auto-Harnessing for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.brief: LongCapHarness以能力为导向构建推理框架，在开发集上递归自改进，更新能力原语实现、能力状态和控制逻辑，挖掘模型已有的长上下文能力。
papers.tldr: 通过递归改进能力组件与控制逻辑，无需后训练即可提升长上下文推理能力。
papers.what_it_is: LongCapHarness以能力为导向构建推理框架，在开发集上递归自改进，更新能力原语实现、能力状态和控制逻辑，挖掘模型已有的长上下文能力。
key_points: 无需数据合成或后训练，应用于Llama3-8B并迁移至Qwen2.5-3B
在HELMET和RULER上显著优于近期数据合成基线
估算开发成本低于NExtLong和PolicyLong训练成本的50%
papers.why_notable: 将长上下文能力提升从昂贵的训练转向推理框架优化，并展示跨模型迁移潜力，为低成本挖掘模型潜在能力提供新路径。
papers.abstract: Existing methods enhancing an LLM's long-context reasoning capability often rely on data synthesis and follow-up LLM post-training. However, the data synthesis strategy and the post-training recipes are empirically driven and computationally intensive. In this work, we propose a new framework, dubbed LongCapHarness, to instead harness the underlying capabilities for long-context reasoning. The harnessing process recursively revises and updates capability primitive implementation, capability state and control logic through recursive self-improvement on the development set. With neither data synthesis nor LLM post-training, LongCapHarness is applied to Llama3-8B and transferred to Qwen2.5-3B. LongCapHarness substantially outperforms recent data-synthesis-based baselines on HELMET and RULER benchmarks; its estimated development cost is less than 50% of the estimated training costs of NExtLong and PolicyLong. We hope these results motivate further research into harnessing the latent capabilities of LLMs to solve tasks beyond their explicit training.

papers.title: The Truth Beneath the Tokens: Prompt-Space Recovery of Knowledge Edits in Language Models
papers.brief: 提出残留知识审计机制 Memento，学习可复用的恢复信号，引导已编辑模型返回编辑前的答案。它无需修改权重，支持连续前缀与离散文本提示。
papers.tldr: 仅靠提示即可恢复模型编辑前的知识，揭示事实被压制而非彻底遗忘的可能。
papers.what_it_is: 提出残留知识审计机制 Memento，学习可复用的恢复信号，引导已编辑模型返回编辑前的答案。它无需修改权重，支持连续前缀与离散文本提示。
key_points: 覆盖3个大模型、5种知识编辑方法
恢复80.07%的留出编辑事实，相对基线提升9.58%
未编辑模型的平均事实召回相对提升53.9%
papers.why_notable: 将知识编辑审计从权重干预转向提示干预，为检验旧知识是否真正消除提供新工具，也揭示模型拥有知识与推理时可访问知识之间的差距。
papers.abstract: Model editing provides an efficient way to update factual knowledge in transformer models. Recent approaches reverse edits by modifying, masking, or decomposing model weights, but make recovery dependent on weight-space interventions. We instead show that pre-edit knowledge can be recovered through input-space interventions alone, without modifying the edited model's weights. We introduce Memento, a prompt-space mechanism for auditing residual knowledge that learns a reusable recovery signal to steer an edited model toward its pre-edit response. Memento supports both continuous recovery prefixes and discrete textual prompts for standard text interfaces. Across three LLMs and five editing techniques, Memento recovers 80.07% of held-out edited facts, achieving a 9.58% relative improvement over baselines, suggesting that editing may suppress the facts without fully eliminating their recoverability. We further investigate whether prompt-space recovery extends beyond model editing. On pristine, unedited LLMs, Memento improves average factual recall by 53.9% relative to standard inference. These results demonstrate the potential of prompt-space recovery for auditing residual knowledge in edited models and investigating the gap between factual knowledge and its accessibility during inference. We will release our source code.

papers.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.brief: MixUA从独立的用户与智能体交互轨迹中提炼经验，按受益对象与泄露风险分配到四种记忆范围，并用混合用户与智能体基准检验共享收益及隐私。
papers.tldr: 按用户与智能体划分记忆共享范围，兼顾跨任务经验复用与隐私保护。
papers.what_it_is: MixUA从独立的用户与智能体交互轨迹中提炼经验，按受益对象与泄露风险分配到四种记忆范围，并用混合用户与智能体基准检验共享收益及隐私。
key_points: MixUA设置用户—智能体对、用户、智能体及全局四级记忆
CrossLearnBench覆盖5名用户、7个智能体及隐私探针
通过率较无记忆最高增16个百分点，偏好保留率最高90%
papers.why_notable: 将经验共享与访问边界统一建模，支持跨用户、跨智能体迁移；禁用范围的隐私探针命中率最高仅0.02%，显示分级记忆的实用价值。
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.
